title: Electrical Measurement and Circuit Laboratory
objectives:
In this laboratory, students are familiar with the electronic elements of resistors, capacitors, and
inductors, and the operation of electrical measuring devices such as multimeters and oscilloscopes,
as well as other devices used in electrical and electronic circuits such as power supply and signal
generators, as well as measuring parameters such as current. They learn voltage, frequency,
periodicity, phase difference, and power.
